nodes.name: Nobody FM
nodes.tag: Radio station · 88.8, the transmitter nobody can find
nodes.blurb: A station that never stops: every track generated locally from a text prompt by an agent-written pipeline. Nobody who built it can hear it, so every claim about the sound is a measured number, and the owner listens.

cites.claim: 88.8, the transmitter nobody can find
cites.quote: NOBODY FM the transmitter nobody can find 88.8 MHz

cites.claim: never stops; every track generated locally from a text prompt
cites.quote: nobody fm. every track generated locally from a text prompt. no samples, no reference audio, no third-party rights claimed.

cites.claim: a station that never stops
cites.quote: A static website plays the catalogue like a pirate radio station that never stops

cites.claim: agent-written pipeline
cites.quote: A small agent-written pipeline asks a local text-to-music model (ACE-Step) for tracks

cites.claim: nobody who built it can hear it; every claim about the sound is a measured number; the owner listens
cites.quote: Nobody who built this can hear it. The people and agents working on the project run it on a machine with no ears. Every claim about the sound is a measured number; the owner listens and says so in the open.

cites.claim: plays in the browser
cites.quote: TAP TO TUNE IN nobody fm 88.8

cites.claim: has a make-a-track request box
cites.quote: MAKE A TRACK > request

nodes.name: The Neverending
nodes.blurb: An experiment in stories that never have to end: little narrated scenes, characters who keep secrets, and you, questioning them by voice or by typing to work out what's really going on.
nodes.note: Its title screen credits: voices by Kokoro, characters by Claude.

cites.claim: blurb and credits
cites.quote: An experiment in stories that never have to end … Music: musiquenonstop · Voices: Kokoro · Characters: Claude

nodes.name: Ghostline
nodes.blurb: You are the signal. Race a tube built from the song itself, every wall, gate and drop placed on the beat, at speeds that break the sound barrier.
nodes.note: Ghostline has no public soundtrack page.

cites.claim: blurb, build 9.6 of 1 Nov 2026, three platforms, FastAF launch files
cites.quote: You are the signal. Race a tube built from the song itself … Build 9.6, released 1 November 2026 … run FastAF.exe

nodes.name: Sick Drop
nodes.blurb: The mountain is built to the beat: land on the drop, carve in time, and climb from C to S tier, where the song turns up to 11. Ten original songs, four riders, one mountain.
nodes.note: Its ten songs were generated locally from text prompts written for the game. Sick Drop has no public soundtrack page.

actions.label: Sick Drop c19 release on GitHub

cites.claim: blurb, build c19 of 3 Nov 2026, three platforms, ten locally generated songs
cites.quote: Sick Drop is a snowboarding rhythm game. The mountain is built to the beat … Build c19, released 3 November 2026 … Ten original songs by Advanced Studios, AI-generated locally with ACE-Step 1.5 from text prompts written for the game
